run.notes: Run 1 of 2 (D1-D3 only). 17 of max 20 raw candidates; stop topic_complete on basis K5 (further D1-D3 reasoning items would be scenario-wrapped recall) and K3 (the remaining ideas belong to run 2, the cardiovascular topic or Grade 9); the K1 reasoning floor was NOT met. Independent review: strict reasoning 2 of 17 = 11.8% (-011, -016), below the 35% SHOULD signal; labels 15 recall / 1 explain / 1 compare; difficulty 15 easy / 2 medium / 0 hard. Gabriel accepted the documented descriptive run-1 exception and keeps all 17; the deficit is carried to R5 as information, not a quota. This is not the whole respiratory bank and not CP1 completion; run 2 (D4-D6) is still pending. No earlier run of this topic exists. Concepts covered: D1 airway order; epiglottis at swallowing; larynx/vocal cords; left vs right lung (heart); pleural fluid friction. D2 inhalation chain; passive quiet expiration; lungs follow chest wall via pleural fluid; diffusion without energy; gas direction from given data; gas exchange location (alveoli vs trachea); O2 use and CO2 waste. D3 trachea cartilage; nasal mucosa warming; cilia and mucus; alveolar wall thinness and capillaries; many alveoli = large surface. Uncovered/deferred: tissue-level (internal) gas exchange and gas transport (cardiovascular topic); control of breathing; image-dependent labelling; all of D4-D6 (run 2). Pages: 6 counted (robots.txt, 4 OpenStax pages, saved MON PDF re-read, no new MON retrieval). All candidates pending; nothing approved. Before handoff the option texts of 11 candidates were revised in place to reduce option-length cueing (prompts, keys, facts, limits and pages unchanged; log in the collector scratch). Bulgarian school-textbook wording was not verified. No fresh retrieval is claimed.

source_ref.document_title: Intro: purpose of the respiratory system

research.concept: D2 · кислородът се използва в клетките, въглеродният диоксид е отпадък
research.notes: 22.1 and 22.4: oxygen is supplied for cellular respiration; CO2 is its waste product. The wording about energy from nutrients is standard curriculum background, not taken from a fetched sentence; the cell process itself is not tested. Blood transport is not used. Scope: programme theme 2.2. Locators, saved 22-4.txt: L10 (CO2 = waste of cellular respiration); L76 (O2 used continuously for cellular respiration); L81 (cellular respiration -> ATP, 'the energy needed').

questions.explanation: Клетките постоянно използват кислород, за да получават енергия от хранителните вещества, а въглеродният диоксид е отпаден продукт, който трябва да бъде отстранен с издишването.
